description: This Java class 'ApplicationConfigProperties' defines configuration properties for an application, including maximum instances and startup timeout, with getter and setter methods, validation, and dynamic calculation based on system resources.

classes.name: ApplicationConfigProperties
classes.description: Configures application-wide properties such as maximum instances and startup timeout.

methods.name: getStartupTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured startup timeout in seconds.

methods.name: setStartupTimeout
methods.description: Sets the startup timeout with validation.

methods.name: getMaxInstances
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of verticles to deploy based on configuration and system resources.

methods.name: setMaxInstances
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of verticles to deploy with validation.
